integrity: The normalization proof uses the source's degree-eight theorem plus an intrinsic projective-bundle calculation and an explicit no-common-vertex check.
The exact j-invariant is recomputed from the four branch points and checked by exact arithmetic.
limitations: Specific to the explicit unlinked-circle Example 3.4.
No claim is made about product normalization for general pairs of conics or about all local analytic singularity types of the edge surface.
title: Product normalization of the unlinked-circle edge surface
